answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and plants a willow tag per key in the canyon registry. Each epoch a random peer runs the tag through a prism table splitting it into origin, effort, freshness; any mismatch burns the bond. Clearing a fake tag costs the auditor its bond. First 40, kth 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. Rented-auditor rings fail when tags share one key. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its bond.
